About the job

Full Stack Engineer – React / Node / TypeScript
Manchester – 3 days per week onsite (Central Manchester)
£45,000 – £60,000 / + Share options

If you're looking to work for a Manchester based early stage startup with big ambitions, a place where you can work closely with founders and shape product decisions this could be an interesting opportunity for you. They're building a consumer-facing platform that is already in market and gaining traction rapidly.

Following continued growth, they are looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to become one of the earliest members of their engineering team.

This is a great opportunity for a strong mid-level developer who wants to progress towards Senior Engineer while having significantly more ownership than you'd typically get in a larger technology team.

You'll work directly with the Founding Engineer and founders, taking features from an initial customer problem through to design, development and release.

What you'll be doing

* Building new features across React, Node.js and TypeScript
* Working across both frontend and backend development
* Taking features from idea through to production
* Building and maintaining APIs and third-party integrations
* Working with payments, notifications and other external services
* Contributing to architecture and technical decisions
* Supporting CI/CD and cloud infrastructure
* Writing clean, maintainable and well-tested code

You'll ideally have:

* 3+ years' commercial software engineering experience
* Strong JavaScript / TypeScript
* Commercial experience with React
* Backend development experience with Node.js
* Genuine full-stack experience rather than being heavily weighted towards just frontend or backend
* Experience working within an early-stage startup or similarly fast-moving product environment

Experience with Stripe, mobile development/Expo, ecommerce, marketplaces or booking platforms would be useful but isn't essential.

The opportunity
You'll be joining a very small engineering team at a point where you'll genuinely be able to influence how the product and technology evolve.

For an intro call this week please apply with an up to date CV
